topic: Your Wi-Fi's Secret Path Through Walls
caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Your Wi-Fi sneaks through walls, but some walls are tougher!

💡 Wi-Fi signals are radio waves that pass through walls, but dense materials like metal or concrete weaken them significantly.
